events.title: Brazil Dance Night — Forró Workshop & Live Music with Anderson Rocha
events.description: A full evening of Brazilian culture at The Yoga Barn: Anderson Rocha opens with a forró fundamentals workshop — footwork, connection, and the lightness of the Northeast Brazilian folk rhythm — before Luz do Sol & Band take the stage for live Brazilian music and an open social dance floor. The format moves from guided learning into free social dancing with a live band, making it accessible to newcomers while rewarding experienced dancers. Forró is one of Brazil's most communal couple dances; this edition brings an authentic slice of it to Ubud's movement community.
